Privacy policy

Your data, in plain English.

Last updated May 16, 2026.

TL;DR. Your voice, your photos, your meals belong to you. We use them to make VoCal work. We don't sell them, we don't ad-target on them, and you can delete everything in one tap.

What we collect

  • Meals you log — name, macros, time, source (voice / photo / manual).
  • Voice transcripts — the text we get back from on-device speech recognition. We use this only to parse the meal.
  • Meal photos — only if you snap one. Auto-deleted after 30 days unless you opt in to keep.
  • Body photos — for the body-fat estimate. Encrypted at rest with a per-user key. Kept 90 days max.
  • Apple Sign-in — your Apple subject identifier (an opaque string), not your real email unless you choose to share it.
  • Usage telemetry — counts of feature taps and crash reports, no content.

What we don't collect

  • Your real name, address, or phone number.
  • Contact list, location, or ad identifiers.
  • Anything from Apple Health unless you grant the permission, and even then only the categories listed in the app.

Where it lives

On your device by default, mirrored to a Cloudflare-hosted backend in the United States. Photos live in Cloudflare R2; structured data in Cloudflare D1. We use Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI to run the AI estimates — transcripts and image features are sent to those providers under their respective privacy commitments.

Your controls

  • Delete a meal: swipe left in the log.
  • Delete a photo: tap the meal, then Photo → Remove.
  • Delete everything: Profile → Privacy → Delete account. All data wiped within 30 days.
  • Export: Profile → Privacy → Export. You get a JSON of your meals + a ZIP of your photos.

Children

VoCal is for 17+. We don't knowingly collect data from younger users.

Changes

If we update this policy, we'll surface a notice in the app. Email privacy@vocal.best with any concerns.
